description: Offline simulation development queue. Pending tasks are not running jobs. The coordinator owns merge order and queue updates.

tasks.title: Multiple resource pools in synthetic encounters
tasks.acceptance: Preserve V1–V4 behavior; add explicit independent resource pools, exact accounting, independent replay, and exhaustive small-case comparisons. No live adapters.

tasks.title: Repeatable offline benchmark suite
tasks.acceptance: Use existing load_profile/evaluate contracts to benchmark tracked synthetic profiles, recording damage, search completeness and repeated timing distributions separately. No core changes or machine-specific timing assertions.

tasks.title: Independent solver correctness and budget audit
tasks.acceptance: Add deterministic small synthetic cases for waiting, horizon boundaries and bounded-search truncation. Report discrepancies with minimal reproductions; leave core fixes to coordinator.

tasks.title: Offline combat-result statistics
tasks.acceptance: Summarize supplied saved or synthetic records by damage, effect kinds, elapsed observation span and coverage limitations. Reject mixed clocks and invalid values. No live collection or game actions.

tasks.title: Channel and periodic effect semantics
tasks.acceptance: Model synthetic channel ticks and interruption outcomes with documented ordering. Preserve old profiles; independently replay and check small exhaustive cases.

tasks.title: Critical damage and probability analysis
tasks.acceptance: Separate hypothetical expected damage from realized damage. Document probability and rounding assumptions; test seeded distributions. Never label expected value as observed game damage.

tasks.title: Stronger synthetic comparison policies
tasks.acceptance: Add effect-aware and resource-aware comparison policies. Keep original baselines and independently replay candidates.

tasks.title: Search performance study
tasks.acceptance: Measure before/after cost using benchmark and correctness suites. Preserve feasibility and truncation reporting; report distributions, not guaranteed latency.

tasks.title: Specialization-style synthetic scenarios
tasks.acceptance: Document hypothetical burst, sustain and periodic archetypes, and compare modeled outcomes under common assumptions. No actual RIFT rotation or ability-stat claims.

tasks.title: Integrated simulation benchmark and handoff
tasks.acceptance: Run the portable suite and reviewed synthetic benchmarks on the integrated revision. Record scope, commands, skip counts, limitations and next unresolved product work.
